Alongside the ongoing all-time low on the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery at 40% off, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by a new Amazon all-time low hitting the 32GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro at $300 off alongside the 48GB M5 Pro MacBook Pro also at $300 off the list price. You can save up to $300 on these M3 iPad Air clearance deals before they are gone for good, and scoop up a mid-range 13-inch M5 iPad Pro sitting down at the Amazon low – $149 off new or $245 off open-box. Just be sure to check out this rare discount on the latest Philips Hue Bridge Pro as stock appears to be quite low. Head below for a closer look.

Now live again: Official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery just dropped back to all-time low at nearly 40% off

Amazon has just dropped the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery back down to its best price to date. We saw this deal come and go very quickly a couple days ago, but it is now back.

Amazon is now once again offering the Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery down at $59.99 shipped. If this offer is anything like last go around, it might not be around for very long.

New Amazon all-time low hits 32GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro at $300 off

As the now discontinued 512GB M5 MacBook Pro models become harder and harder to come across – the 32GB model we featured over the weekend is completely out of stock, Amazon has now dropped its 32GB/1TB model to its best price ever at $300 off.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 32GB of RAM and the 1TB Internal SSD down to $1,799 shipped.

This is a regularly $2,099 configuration seeing a straight up $300 price drop here today to deliver the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon to date.

Unlike many of the particularly notable M5 and M5 Pro MacBook Pro deals we have featured over the last month or so, this one is actually landing on the classic Silver livery as opposed to the Space Black. Both Amazon and B&H are charging $50 more for the Space Black 32GB/1TB.

While we have tracked some of the now rather elusive 512GB M5 MacBook Pro models at as much as $350 off the original list prices, this 32GB/1TB is still sold at Apple for $2,099. And after the lineup effectively received a price cut for upgraded models like the one featured here, this is actually one of the very best MacBook Pro deals we have tracked all year in terms of how deep the discount is.

In some cases, when you get up into the heavily upgraded RAM and storage specs it might make more sense to jump up to the more powerful M5 Pro/Max chip, but that’s not really the case here: It is $300 off the list price and $400 under the MSRP on the most affordable M5 Pro model, and $150 under the deal price on the least expensive M5 Pro.

  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,899 (Reg. $3,099)

Save up to $300 on these M3 iPad Air clearance deals before they are gone for good

While I generally like to stay as up to date as possible when it comes to Apple gear purchases, previous-generation iPad models are a great way to save some money. Some folks use an iPad as their main machine, but for me that’s the Mac, and these M3 iPad Air clearance deals at up to $300 off are seriously calling my name.

There are some of the higher-capacity models at up to $300 off, but it is this 11-inch 256GB model in blue that is really catching my eye. As much as I really don’t need the new M4 iPad Air, I also do not need all that much internal storage when it comes to my iPad usage, and this Wi-Fi + Cell model with the option for an always-connected setup or not at $599 seems like a really nice middle ground.

Regularly $849, you can now land this 11-inch M3 iPad Air with 256GB of storage at $599 shipped. That’s $250 off, the lowest price we have ever tracked on Amazon, and it is now back in-stock and ready to roll.

It also sits alongside some other lingering M3 clearance deals you can scope out below:

  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 256GB $599 (Reg. $849) – new Amazon all-time low
  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 512GB $799 (Reg. $1,049) – new Amazon all-time low
  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 1TB $949 (Reg. $1,249) – new Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 1TB $1,149 (Reg. $1,449) – new Amazon all-time low

M4 iPad Air

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $556 (Reg. $599)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $649 (Reg. $699)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $834 (Reg. $899)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,009 (Reg. $1,099)

Mid-range 13-inch M5 iPad Pro sitting down at Amazon low: $149 off new, $245 off open-box

Deals on the latest M5 iPad Pro lineup have been light to say the least this year. We have seen a few chances to save some cash, but not a whole lot, and especially not on the more affordable end of the lineup. For this reason we are surfacing the Amazon low pricing on the mid-range 13-inch 512GB model at nearly $150 off today.

Anyone looking to get in on some iPad Pro action this summer will want to take a look at Amazon’s listing on the 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 512GB model at $1,349.99 shipped. Both the Silver and Space Black models are sitting at this discounted rate right now.

Regularly $1,499, this $149 off the list price and matching the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon on this model. While some of the more pricey variants have been $200 off or better, this one has not seen deals quite as generous, and for good reason – it is arguably one of the best models to buy for folks who aren’t total iPad Pro power users.

Over at Best Buy you’ll pay an extra $50 for this config right now, but it is offering “excellent” open-box units down as low as $1,255.99 shipped. That’s $243 off and the best we can find in this sort of condition from a source as reputable – the listing also says it includes a 1-year Apple warranty.

Apple’s latest Magic Mouse sitting at best Amazon price ever if you need a fresh one

Update 5/12: This rare discounts is still live, but the Crutchfield listing is now marked with a low stock warning.

Deals on the latest Philips Hue Bridge Pro have been rare at best – it was hard to even get at full price for a while there. While it is still out of stock on the official Hue site, it has been readily available on Amazon at full price some time now, and we are catching a rare discount today at just over $79 via Crutchfield.

The standard aluminum variants are the more popular options, if not just because of the far more affordable price, and the deals are still live on most of those, but the deep discounts on the high-end models are back as well on select colors:
